title: Doubao gives all users a free 30-day subscription benefit: Standard plan free trial until October 17th

content_html:
On September 24, ByteDance's AI assistant Douyin announced that it would offer all users a 30-day subscription benefit for free. Both free and paid users can claim the standard package, which is available for free trial until October 17. The official subscription page shows that the standard package offered in this promotion is marked as "Promotion Gift," with an expiration date of October 17. Users can claim and check the activation status on the subscription and quota management page.

Under the benefit mechanism, Douyin adopts a subscription plus quota operation model: users can upgrade to a paid subscription to gain priority during peak hours or purchase creation quota packages to expand usage. Quotas are calculated based on the current period and the past seven days, starting from the time of use, and the page supports quota reset and subscription record inquiry.

Notably, this is the latest in a series of free subscription benefits provided by Douyin: subscription records show that users previously received a one-month standard package in June and a one-month premium package in July. Continuous free promotions for all users are generally seen as an operational move by Douyin to lower the payment threshold, cultivate subscription habits, and expand the base of paying users, continuously preparing for future conversion to paid users.

Currently, domestic AI assistants are generally shifting towards a subscription plus quota business model. Manufacturers use free subscriptions to bring trial users into the subscription system and then use peak-time priority and creation quota packages as paid features. After the competition for user acquisition has slowed down, leading AI applications are shifting their focus from model capabilities to commercialization and user operations. This promotion continues the industry trend of using free trials to drive paid conversions.
